assets.prompt:

Composition template for a matching 10-icon set: one classic black-and-white soccer ball centered at approximately (725,300), diameter 310 pixels, in the upper right. A thick themed comet swoosh curves diagonally behind the ball toward lower left, ending near (170,800). Keep ALL artwork including outlines and extras inside x=123..901 and y=123..901: 12% empty fully transparent padding on every side. Ball orientation: central black pentagonal panel with bold black seams and surrounding white panels, front three-quarter view. The ball is drawn in front of the swoosh.
GALE SWOOSH ONLY: curling white and pale sky-blue wind ribbons (#F4FBFF, #A0E0FF) ending in 2-3 spiral wind curls at lower left. Clear thick connected wind silhouette.
Shared style: bright vibrant high-contrast cartoon, simple rounded readable shapes, EXTRA THICK solid pure black #000000 outer outline and bold black inner lines. Flat saturated candy colors, only two clean hard-edged cel-shading tones, minimal tiny highlight. Matte illustration. Small extras also have thick solid black outlines.
Strictly NO soft gradients, glossy shine, bloom, glow, rays, cast shadow, photorealism, text, letters, numbers, labels, frame, tile, background. ONE icon, never multiple icons, grid, collage or sprite sheet.
